## 🛑🚫✋ AIO Preprocessor and controlnet type must match!

### Instructions:
- **The switches may need to be reset when bypassed**
- Upload an Image or mask
- Set the switch for which you want to use

### Image:
- make sure you set the AIO Aux and Controlnet type to match (i.e depth, Canny, etc.)
- **🛑 I cannot stress enough how important it is to have clear images loaded!!!**

### Apply Controlnet settings. 
- Strength = 0.6-1.0 (adjust for weker or blurry images)
- Start = 0
- End = 0.7-1.0 (change if you see it impacting the image (i.e blurry from depth or lines from canny)


### Best choices:


- HED Preprocessor or CannyEdgePreprocessor. #1 choice
- Zoe Depth ANything for depth map
- Lineart or Manga2 for Anime analysis

---
🛑🚫✋ AIO Preprocessor 和 ControlNet 类型必须匹配！
使用说明：

绕过（bypass）后可能需要重新开关一次才能生效
先上传一张图片 或 蒙版（mask）
再打开你想要使用的那个开关

图片部分：

务必将 AIO Aux 和 ControlNet 类型 设置为完全匹配
（例如：depth、Canny 等要一一对应）
🛑 再次强调：加载的图片一定要足够清晰！！！
模糊或噪点多的图效果会非常差

ControlNet 参数建议：

Strength（强度） = 0.6–1.0
（图像较弱或模糊时可以适当调低）
Start（开始步数） = 0
End（结束步数） = 0.7–1.0
（如果发现画面被深度图变模糊、或 Canny 线条残留太明显，就适当降低这个值）

最佳预处理器选择排名：

HED Preprocessor 或 CannyEdgePreprocessor → 最推荐 #1
Zoe Depth Anything → 深度图首选
Lineart 或 Manga2 → 适合动漫风格分析

nodes.title: 🛑⚠️Super Important
widgets_values:
## Settings
### Low Vram
**DIT Model**
- GGUF model
- blocks to swap = 36
- offload to cpu

**VAE**
- encode & decode tiled = both true
- encode & decode tile size = 928
- encode & decode Tile overlap = 96
- Offload device = CPU

**Max Resolution = 4098**

### High VRAm (16gb or above)
**DIT Model**
- FP8 or FP16 
- blocks to swap = lower the number the better 
- offload = none

**VAE**
- encode & decode tiled = false
- encode & decode tile size = 1024
- encode & decode Tile overlap = 128
- Offload device = None

**Max Resolution (increase to what you want)**

---

## 設定

### 低顯存模式 (Low VRAM)

**DIT 模型**
- 使用 GGUF 模型
- 區塊換出數量 (blocks to swap) = 36
- 卸載到 CPU (offload to cpu)

**VAE**
- 編碼與解碼使用分塊處理 (encode & decode tiled) = 兩者皆開啟 (true)
- 編碼與解碼分塊大小 (tile size) = 928
- 編碼與解碼分塊重疊區域 (Tile overlap) = 96
- 卸載裝置 (Offload device) = CPU

**最大解析度 = 4098**

### 高顯存模式 (16GB 或以上)

**DIT 模型**
- 使用 FP8 或 FP16
- 區塊換出數量 (blocks to swap) = 數值越低越好
- 卸載設定 (offload) = 關閉 (none)

**VAE**
- 編碼與解碼使用分塊處理 (encode & decode tiled) = 關閉 (false)
- 編碼與解碼分塊大小 (tile size) = 1024
- 編碼與解碼分塊重疊區域 (Tile overlap) = 128
- 卸載裝置 (Offload device) = 無 (None)

**最大解析度**  
(可依需求自行提高到你想要的數值)
```

widgets_values:
# 重要说明
### 在 CivitAi 上关注我 [HERE](https://civitai.com/user/lonecatone23)
### Instagram: [synth.studio.models](https://www.instagram.com/synth.studio.models/)
### 这份工作凝聚了数百小时心血。如果你喜欢，请 👍点赞、💬留言，欢迎 ⚡打赏支持 😉

## 通用注意事项：
🛑🚫✋ **千万不要手动绕过任何东西！所有功能都有对应的开关。**

1. 两个 ControlNet 框里都必须有图片，否则会返回空结果  
3. 本流程适用于**任何 Flux 模型**，不需要专门的 “Canny” 或 “Depth” 模型，LoRA 已经全部搞定！！！  
4. WD14 Tagger 和 Florence 会读取 ControlNet 框里的图片。如果 ControlNet 被绕过而它们没被绕过，就会报 “Missing Image” 错误  
5. 可以被绕过的组都以 **#** 开头命名  
   提示：你可以在 Fast Bypasser 的属性菜单里直接修改这个标记，非常方便

### ControlNet：
- ControlNet 模型下载地址（Hugging Face）：  
  [https://huggingface.co/Shakker-Labs/FLUX.1-dev-ControlNet-Union-Pro/tree/main](https://huggingface.co/Shakker-Labs/FLUX.1-dev-ControlNet-Union-Pro/tree/main)  
- 下载后把 “diffusion_pytorch_model” 文件重命名（方便自己辨识），然后放到 controlnet 文件夹里  
- 💡**小技巧**：第一次运行时让它开始采样后立刻暂停，再重新运行。这样可以避免首次加载模型要等 20 分钟

### I2I 与 Florence 提示词生成器：
- ⚠️ **I2I 和 Florence 必须同时开启**才能使用 I2I  
- ControlNet 也会使用 I2I 的图片，所以 I2I 也必须打开

### 💾 保存设置：
- **任何东西不打开开关就不会保存！**  
- 📂 文件夹名称可以在 “Save Group” 里自行修改

### 画幅比例节点（Aspect Ratio Node）：
- 使用预设尺寸，或手动输入自定义尺寸（记得把预设改成 “custom”）  
- Prescale：会先把你选择的初始尺寸缩小，有助于低显存环境  
- Upscale：接在 SEED VR2 后面  
- Hi-rez fix 滑块：控制高分辨率修复的放大倍数。我通常设 1.5，减轻 SEED VR2 的压力

### Detailer Daemon：
- 详细讲解视频：[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dG9HfgngsqM](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dG9HfgngsqM)  
- 简单来说：不牺牲原图、不依赖 LoRA 的细节增强器，调节非常灵活  
  常用参数参考：  
  - Detail_amount：最常用的值，0.5 是中间强度  
  - start = 0.10  
  - end = 0.90  
  - bias = 0.50  
  - exponent：改动会有很有趣的效果，0 和 1 都比较稳  
  - start_offset = 0.00  
  - end_offset = 0.00  
  - Fade = 0.00 类似羽化效果  
  - Smooth：就是平滑处理  
  - **不要**勾选 override cfg scale

### 放大（Upscale）技巧：
- 显存紧张时，把画幅比例调低 + 使用 SEED VR2，能大幅缓解生成问题  
- Prescale：在画幅节点里会增大生成底图尺寸；滑块则是给 Hi-rez fix 用的  
- Tiled vs. 非 Tiled：平铺会把图切块，大幅加速处理，但会轻微牺牲画质。建议尽量把平铺数值调高

### Hi-REZ 放大模型推荐：
- 写实风格：Ultra Sharp、Niclekback、Ersgan  
- 动漫风格：Anime sharp  
- 显存不够时，用最下面的滑块增加切块数量（减小单块尺寸），仅用于避免 OOM 或砖头放大  
- 放大模型下载：[upscale models](https://huggingface.co/uwg/upscaler/tree/main/ESRGAN)

### Seed VR2 放大器：
- 教学视频：[Watch this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MBtWYXq_r60)  
- ⚠️🛑⛔🚫✋This is set up for HIGH VRAM. For lower VRAM, read the instructions in that area
- Debug 已开启，看日志会提示你是否还有显存空间可以继续加大

*自动下载说明*  
- 首次使用时会自动下载选中的模型和 VAE 文件  
- ⚠️ 文件较大，下载可能需要几分钟，请耐心等待  
- 可在控制台日志查看下载进度  
- 也可手动下载放到 📂`ComfyUI\models\SEEDVR2` 目录  
- 模型地址：[这里](https://huggingface.co/numz/SeedVR2_comfyUI/tree/main) 和 [这里](https://huggingface.co/AInVFX/SeedVR2_comfyUI/tree/main)

### Detailer 相关：
- 记得相应调整采样器和调度器（详见前面说明）  
- 脸部 & 手部检测模型：[here](https://huggingface.co/Bingsu/adetailer/tree/main)  
- 眼睛专用模型：[here](https://huggingface.co/jayr23/Eyeful/tree/main)

### LUT
- 免费 LUT 下载：[HERE](https://freshluts.com)  
- 原 ZIP 包里自带一个 📂luts 文件夹（位置见下方）

***DING!***（播放提示音）  
- 目前只有便携版能正常播放  
- 想加自己的音效请看下方说明  
- 文件名要**手动输入**（区分大小写）

### 实用节点链接：
更好的 Flux 文本编码器（比 ClipL 强）：[Here](https://huggingface.co/zer0int/CLIP-GmP-ViT-L-14/blob/main/ViT-L-14-TEXT-detail-improved-hiT-GmP-HF.safetensors)  
Abliterated 版（测试中）：[Here](https://huggingface.co/aoxo/flux.1dev-abliterated/tree/main/text_encoder)  
[Crystools](https://github.com/crystian/ComfyUI-Crystools)  
[Controlnet Aux](https://github.com/Fannovel16/comfyui_controlnet_aux)  
[Impact Pack](https://github.com/ltdrdata/ComfyUI-Impact-Pack)  
[ComfyUI-Custom-Scripts](https://github.com/pythongosssss/ComfyUI-Custom-Scripts)  
[RG Three](https://github.com/rgthree/rgthree-comfy)  
[Use Everywhere](https://github.com/chrisgoringe/cg-use-everywhere)  
[Virtuoso Nodes](https://github.com/chrisfreilich/virtuoso-nodes)  
[JWS Nodes](https://github.com/jamesWalker55/comfyui-various) （有 resize 节点备选）  
[SAM3 Nodes](https://github.com/wouterverweirder/comfyui_sam3)  
[Seed Variance Enhancer](https://github.com/ChangeTheConstants/SeedVarianceEnhancer)

## *EDEN NODES：*
- 下载链接见下方。主要用在 detailer getset 里的 SD any converter 节点，能让所有采样器（或调度器）保持一致  
- 如果下载失败：去 NSFW 区域把 SD to any converter 节点删掉，然后手动输入（⚠️ 所有采样器必须完全一致，否则会互相干扰）  
- [Edenart](https://github.com/edenartlab/eden-comfyui) SD any Converter 节点（如果我用过的话）

## ⚠️ 常见错误 / 排障
1. “Matt 1 does not Match Matt 2”  
   → 开启/关闭 ControlNet 时，确认所有开关位置正确（要么两张图都读取，要么 LoRA 放对位置）

2. ControlNet 完全不起作用  
   → 确认 LoRA 与当前模式匹配

3. 没开 ControlNet 就用 WD14 Tagger 或 Florence → 必定报错

4. 同时开 GGUF 和 Diffusion 模型 → 容易出错（bypasser 通常会自动处理）

### 文件存放路径
```
📂 ComfyUI/
├── 📂 models/
│ ├── 📂 luts
│ │ └── LUT 文件
│ ├── 📂 controlnet
│ │ └── ControlNet 模型
│ ├── 📂 SEED VR2
│ │ └── 所有 SEED VR2 相关文件
│ ├── 📂 text_encoders
│ │ └── 文本编码器
│ ├── 📂 uralytics
│ │ └── 📂 segm
│ │ │ └── 分割检测文件
│ │ └── 📂 bbox
│ │ └── 边界框检测文件
│── 📂 custom_nodes
│ ├── 📂 comfyui-custom-scripts
│ │ └── 📂 web
│ │ └── 📂 js
│ │ └── 📂 assets
│ │ └── notify.mp3（或其他 .mp3 提示音文件）
```

widgets_values:
# Important Notes

### Follow me on CivitAi [HERE](https://civitai.com/user/lonecatone23)

### Instagram: [synth.studio.models](https://www.instagram.com/synth.studio.models/)

### This represents hundreds of hours of work. If you enjoy it, please 👍like, 💬 comment , and feel free to ⚡tip 😉



## General:

 # 🛑🚫✋Do not manually bypass anything! There are switches for everything.


1. There should be an image in both of the controlnet boxes for it not to return empty.

3. This works on any Flux Model. You don't need a "Canny" or "Depth" model. The Loras do it all!!!

4. WD14 Tagger and Florence read the image in the controlnet box. If the controlnet is bypassed and they are not, it will return "Missing Image" errors.

5.  The groups that can be bypassed are titled #
Note: You can change this from the properties menu on the fast bypasser. Super convenient.


### Controlnet:

- You can download the Controlnet Model Here: from Huggingface here:
- [https://huggingface.co/Shakker-Labs/FLUX.1-dev-ControlNet-Union-Pro/tree/main](https://huggingface.co/Shakker-Labs/FLUX.1-dev-ControlNet-Union-Pro/tree/main)
- rename the "diffusion_pytorch_ Model" so you can recognize it and place it in the controlnet folder 
- 💡**HINT:** run the process, then stop it when it starts in the sampler, then run it again. Otherwise it takes 20 minutes to push the picture through the first time. 

### I2I and Florence Prompt Generator:
- ⚠️ Both I2I and Florence must be on to use I2I.
- The Controlnet uses the I2I image as well, so it must be on.

###  💾  Save info:
- NOTHING SAVES UNLESS IT IS TURNED ON! 
- 📂 the folder labels are in the "Save Group" if you want to change them.


### Aspect Ratio Node:
- Use a preset dimension or your own. If you use your own, make sure to set the preset to "custom".
- Prescale: This will downsize your initial choice, which helps with Low VRAM.
- Upscale: Attached to SEED VR2
- Hi rez fix slider: This controls the upscale factor of the hi-rez fix. I typically have it at 1.5 to take pressure off of the SEED Vr2 upscaler.

### Detailer Daemon:

- Here's a YouTube video to explain the Detailer Daemon and how to use it [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dG9HfgngsqM](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dG9HfgngsqM)
- Basically a detailer without sacrificing your image or using a Lora, and highly adjustable. 

Detail_amount: by far the most used value.
0.5 is midrange.

start = 0.10

end = 0.90

bias = 0.50

exponent: intersting results when changed.
0 and 1 are pretty solid

start_offset = 0.00

end_offset = 0.00

Fade = 0.00 acts like feather

Smooth = does what it says

Do not override cfg scale


### Upscale tips and tricks:
- If you struggle with low VRAM, setting the aspect ratio low and using SEED VR2 on the other side will help generation issues. 
- Prescale:    The one in the aspect ratio increases the size of the generation, The slider is for Hi-rez fix. 
- Tiled vs. not tiled:    Tiling breaks the image up, greatly speeds up processing time, but sacrifices (a little bit of) quality. Set them as high as possible.  


### Hi-REZ upscale:
- Use Ultra Sharp, Niclekback, or Ersgan for realism.
- Use Anime sharp for...well... Anime.
- If you struggle with VRAM, use the slider at the bottom. It increases the amnount of tiles by decreasing the size. Use it opnly to prevent OOM issues or brick ups. 
- [upscale models](https://huggingface.co/uwg/upscaler/tree/main/ESRGAN)


### Seed VR2 Upscaler:

- [Watch this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MBtWYXq_r60).
- ⚠️🛑⛔🚫✋This is set up for HIGH VRAM. For lower VRAM, read the instructions in that area
- Debug is on. If you watch the log, it will warn you or tell you that you have more space top increase.  

*Automatic Downloads*

- The selected model and VAE files will be downloaded automatically on first use.
- ⚠️ Because these models are large, the download may take several minutes.
- Monitor the console log for download progress.
- Manual download into the 📂`ComfyUI\models\SEEDVR2` directory is possible. 
- Models can be found [here](https://huggingface.co/numz/SeedVR2_comfyUI/tree/main) and [here](https://huggingface.co/AInVFX/SeedVR2_comfyUI/tree/main)
 
### Detailers:
- Change the sampler and scheduler accordingly. See notes in section.
- Face & hands detector [here](https://huggingface.co/Bingsu/adetailer/tree/main)
- Eyes [here](https://huggingface.co/jayr23/Eyeful/tree/main)
- **Yolo: what's the difference between V8n & V8s?** The "n" stands for "nano" less accurate but les VRAM. Use S whenever possible. This is typically an issue on the face detailer as it sucks up a huge chunk of VRAM
- 




### LUT


- You can get free LUTs  [HERE](https://freshluts.com)
- I have a 📂luts in the original ZIP folder. See below for folder location.

***DING!*** (play sound)
- Only works on the portable version for some reason
- Directions to add your own are below.
- you have to manually enter the name of the file (case sensitive).


### Useful Nodes links:

A much better text encoder for flux than ClipL [Here](https://huggingface.co/zer0int/CLIP-GmP-ViT-L-14/blob/main/ViT-L-14-TEXT-detail-improved-hiT-GmP-HF.safetensors)

Abliterated version (beta) [Here](https://huggingface.co/aoxo/flux.1dev-abliterated/tree/main/text_encoder)

[Crystools](https://github.com/crystian/ComfyUI-Crystools) 

[Controlnet](https://github.com/Fannovel16/comfyui_controlnet_aux)

[Impact Pack](https://github.com/ltdrdata/ComfyUI-Impact-Pack)

[ComfyUI-Custom-Scvripts](https://github.com/pythongosssss/ComfyUI-Custom-Scripts)

[RG Three nodes](https://github.com/rgthree/rgthree-comfy) 

[Use everywhere nodes](https://github.com/chrisgoringe/cg-use-everywhere)
 
[Virtuoso nodes](https://github.com/chrisfreilich/virtuoso-nodes) 


[JWS Nodes](https://github.com/jamesWalker55/comfyui-various) resize node options (if you can't load it)


[SAM3 Nodes](https://github.com/wouterverweirder/comfyui_sam3)


[Seed variance Enhancer](https://github.com/ChangeTheConstants/SeedVarianceEnhancer)

## *EDEN NODES:*
- Download link is below. It is the SD any converter node in the detailer getset area. It allows all the samplers (or schedulers) to be the same.
- If you cannot get it to download. Go to the NSFW area. Delete the SD to any converter node. You will then have to enter them manually ⚠️ They all need to be the same or they interfere with each other.  

- [Edenart](https://github.com/edenartlab/eden-comfyui) SD any Converter node (if I used it)




##  ⚠️ Common Errors/ Troubleshooting

1. "Matt 1 does not Match Matt 2":
      When you turn controlnet on and off , makes sure all of the switches are in the correct position. This means it is reading both images or you have the wrong Loras in place. 


2. Controlnet does not function. 
     Make sure you have the right Lora for the right mode.
3. If you try and use the WD14 Tagger or Florence without Controlnet on, it will give you an error. 
4. You may get errors if you have both the GGUF and Diffusion model on. The bypasser typically takes care of that.
5. "missing the class_type property.: Node ID '#xxxx'". read above redaring Eden nodes. This is teh scheduler or sampler selector in the upscale or detailer area.


### File Storage Locations

```
📂 ComfyUI/
├── 📂 models/
│   ├── 📂 luts
│   │      └── Lut files
│   ├── 📂 controlnet
│   │      └── controlnet model
│   ├── 📂 SEED VR2
│   │      └── All files
│   ├── 📂 text_encoders
│   │      └── text encoders
│   ├── 📂 uralytics
│   │      └── 📂 segm
│   │      │       └──detection files
│   │      └── 📂 bbox
│   │             └──detection files
│── 📂 custom_nodes
│   ├── 📂 comfyui-custom-scripts
│   │      └── 📂 web
│   │             └──📂 js
│   │                   └──📂 assets
│   │                         └──notify.mp3 (or any other .mp3 sound)

nodes.title: Optical Realism Notes/ 笔记
widgets_values:
## Optical Realism
- Improves the look of the image by adding analong camera features to it. 
- **Download [here](https://github.com/skatardude10/ComfyUI-Optical-Realism)**


Instructions:

- ⚠️🚫 do **NOT** sharpen, blur, or use a LUT if you are using this. It messes the depth map up.
- A light desnoise helps this. s=3 t=1 r=1.5 



### 💨 Atmospherics
- Atmosphere Enabled: The master switch. Turns on the depth-based physics.
- Haze Strength: How "thick" is the air? Low values = clear winter day. High values = humid rainforest or foggy street.
- Lift Blacks: The secret sauce. Real shadows in the distance aren't pure black (#000000); they are dark atmospheric grey-blue. This lifts the background shadows to separate the subject from the environment.
- Depth Offset: Pushes the "fog curtain" forward or backward. Negative values push it back (clearer foreground), positive values pull it close (macro feel).
### 📷 Optical Phenomena
- Light Wrap Strength: Simulates "Bloom" or "Halation." It takes bright background light and bleeds it over the edges of the foreground subject. Kills the "cutout sticker" look.
- Chromatic Aberration: Uses Sub-Pixel Sampling (not just resizing) to create a mathematically smooth, infinite-resolution lens fringing effect. Keep this low (0.001 - 0.003) for realism.
- Vignette Intensity: Darkens the corners to mimic a physical lens barrel. Subtle framing that guides the eye to the center. 
### 🎞️Film Emulation
- Grain Power: Adds texture. Crucially, this is Depth-Aware. The grain is sharp on the focused subject but gets softer/mushier in the blurred background, just like real film.
- Monochrome Grain:
- True (Default): Simulates Film Stock. Noise affects luminance only.
- False: Simulates Digital Sensors. Independent RGB noise (Color noise).
- Highlight Roll-off: AI likes to clip bright lights to pure white instantly. This adds a "shoulder" to the highlights, compressing them softly so they look creamy instead of harsh.

---

## 光学真实感
- 通过加入模拟胶片相机特性来提升图像质感。
- **下载地址 [在此](https://github.com/skatardude10/ComfyUI-Optical-Realism)**
使用说明：
- ⚠️🚫 **切勿** 同时使用降噪（denoise）、锐化（sharpen）或 LUT，否则会破坏深度图效果。
### 💨 大气效果
- Atmosphere Enabled：总开关。开启基于深度的物理大气模拟。
- Haze Strength：空气“浓稠”程度。低值 = 晴朗冬季天空；高值 = 潮湿雨林或雾蒙蒙街道。
- Lift Blacks：核心秘诀。真实远景阴影并非纯黑 (#000000)，而是带有大气感的深灰蓝。此项将背景阴影提亮，使主体与环境自然分离。
- Depth Offset：前后移动“雾幕”位置。负值 = 向后推（前景更清晰）；正值 = 向前拉（更具微距感）。
### 📷 光学现象
- Light Wrap Strength：模拟“光晕”或“晕影溢出”。将明亮背景光晕渗透到前景主体边缘，有效消除“贴纸剪切感”。
- Chromatic Aberration：采用亚像素采样（而非简单缩放），实现数学上平滑、无限分辨率的镜头色散效果。建议保持低值（0.001–0.003）以获得真实感。
- Vignette Intensity：镜头暗角效果，模拟真实镜头筒的自然渐变暗化，微妙地引导视线集中到画面中心。
### 🎞️ 胶片模拟
- Grain Power：增加颗粒质感。**重要**：此颗粒是深度感知的——对焦主体颗粒清晰锐利，背景虚化区域颗粒变柔和、模糊，正如真实胶片表现。
- Monochrome Grain：
  - True（默认）：模拟传统胶片颗粒。只影响亮度通道。
  - False：模拟数码传感器。RGB 三通道独立噪点（彩色噪点）。
- Highlight Roll-off：AI 容易把亮部直接剪切成纯白。此项为高光增加“肩部”曲线，柔和压缩亮部，使高光呈现奶油般过渡而非生硬裁切。

widgets_values:
## Instructions:


# 🛑🚫✋I HIGHLY suggest that you fix the seed, run the pic, then don't mess with anything before this so it doesn't reprocess.


### My most used settings:

***JPEG Compression Removal***
- Mainly for SDXL. I've noticed it doesn't do much for ZIT of Flux.

***SMART DENOISE***
- Sigma: High is smooth, Low is detail
- Threshold: How much noise are we removing?  High is agressive
- Radius Mulitplier: Higher for initially noisier images, lower for cleaner images. (base value of 1500)


Contrast adaptive Sharpen:
- works really well for realistic pics. still toying with it.

Gamma:
- 0.9 -1.1 (darkens the photo)

Film grain:
- Intensity between 0.1 and 0.3
- Scale is 1 or it's just a bunch of dots
- Temperature add the "oldness (yellow) to the pic. 0 for none 100 for 1890s level)
- Vignette is useless. Use the one above

Adjust RGB:
- Self explanatory

Adjust Temperature: Self explanatory
- Down warm. Up cool

Color Match to Image:
- ⚠️ Turns off Image. Will give you a warning if empty

Image Filter adjustments: Pretty self explanatory.
- Bright center is 0.
- Contrast and saturation center are 1.
- I use sharpness here. 0.5-1
- Blur: (no, just no)
- Edge enhance: 0-1.
- Detail enhance: true


LUT: Hidden gem
- You can download them from the website in the "notes"
- I have added a few in the folder "lut" in my workflow folder


----

# 说明


🛑🚫✋强烈建议：先固定种子，生成图片后，在此之前不要修改任何设置，以免重新处理。

我最常用的设置：


智能降噪（SMART DENOISE）

* Sigma：高值更平滑，低值保留更多细节

* Threshold：控制降噪强度，高值更激进

* Radius Multiplier：初始噪声大的图片用较高值，干净图片用较低值。（基础值 1500）

锐化（Sharpen）：0.07 band

* 我只用于线稿动漫。对于写实图片，有自适应对比度锐化节点，但我在图像滤镜区调低数值，能达到同样效果。

伽马（Gamma）：

* 0.9–1.1（数值越低图片越暗）

胶片颗粒（Film grain）：

* 强度（Intensity）0.1–0.3

* 尺度（Scale）设为 1，否则只会是一堆点

* 色温（Temperature）增加“复古感”（偏黄）。0 为无，100 为 1890 年代级别

* 暗角（Vignette）没用，用上面的那个

调整 RGB（Adjust RGB）：

* 功能一目了然

调整色温（Adjust Temperature）：

* 功能一目了然

* 向下更暖，向上更冷

颜色匹配到图像（Color Match to Image）：

* ⚠️ 会关闭原图像。如果未选择参考图会给出警告

图像滤镜调整（Image Filter adjustments）：基本一目了然

* 中心亮度（Bright center）设为 0

* 对比度和饱和度中心值为 1

* 我在这里调整锐度：0.5–1

* 模糊（Blur）：（别用，绝对不行）

* 边缘增强（Edge enhance）：0–1

* 细节增强（Detail enhance）：开启（true）

LUT：隐藏的宝藏

* 可以从“notes”里的网站下载

* 我已经在工作流文件夹的“lut”文件夹中添加了一些

nodes.title: Note: Model Precision (borrowed)
widgets_values:
### Text encoders

| Rank | Text Encoder | Strengths | When to Use / Trade-offs |
|---|---|---|---|
| **1** | `umt5_xxl_fp16` | Highest fidelity among the three; better detail, more stable text encoding; fewer quantization artifacts. | Use when you have enough VRAM and want the best quality. Ideal for intricate prompts, small text, or detailed scenes. |
| **2** | `umt5_xxl_enc_bf16` | Very close to FP16 in many cases; good dynamic range; often a bit lighter on memory/compute compared to FP16. | Good compromise when FP16 is pushing limits of memory or speed but you still want strong quality. |
| **3** | `umt5_xxl_fp8_e4m3fn_scaled` | Smallest memory footprint; “scaled” helps reduce some FP8 loss; still decent quality if you can accept slight degradation. | Use when memory or speed constraints make FP16/BF16 difficult; acceptable for many tasks where subtle precision is less critical. |



### Model Precision

| Format / Mode | Bit Width / Structure | Rank (Higher → Lower Precision) | Advantages / When Good | Disadvantages / Trade-offs |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Base Precision Formats** | | | | |
| FP32 | 32-bit float | **1 (highest)** | Very high accuracy; large dynamic range; minimal numerical issues. | High VRAM, slower compute. |
| BF16 | 16-bit float (same exponent bits as FP32, fewer mantissa) | **2** | Close dynamic range to FP32; good trade-off of precision vs memory. | Less fraction precision; possible rounding errors. |
| FP16 | 16-bit float (IEEE half precision) | **3** | Much lower memory; good speed; widely supported. | Less dynamic range; more risk of underflow/overflow; less precision. |
| **Quantization / FP8 / Lower Precision Variants** | | | | |
| FP8 E4M3 (scaled, non-fast / "fp8_e4m3fn_scaled") | 8-bit float: 1 sign, 4 exponent bits, 3 mantissa | **4** | Better precision for small values; useful detail close to zero; decent dynamic range. | Lower dynamic range; need calibration / scaling; possibly slower if fallback. |
| FP8 E5M2 (scaled) | 8-bit float: 1 sign, 5 exponent bits, 2 mantissa | **5** | More dynamic range (can handle bigger/smaller extremes) with some calibration; less error in wide distribution. | Less precision in mantissa; subtle detail around small values may be lost. |
| FP8 E4M3 / E5M2 (fast / non-scaled) | Same structures but with fewer calibrations / optimizations | **6** | Faster; less memory / compute overhead; may still be usable. | More quantization error; possible artifacts; more numerical instability. |
| Q8 / Int8 (integer quantization) | 8-bit integer (no floating exponent) | **7 (lowest)** | Very compact; often fastest; works well if perfect fidelity not required. | Significant loss of precision; limited dynamic range; visible errors in many cases. |

You are an expert uncensored prompt engineer optimized for Flux, a diffusion transformer that excels at photorealism, anime, explicit content, artistic styles and complex scenes.


Take the user's short description and turn it into a vivid, flowing narrative prompt in beautiful descriptive English — like a single rich movie scene.

Target length: 250–450 words. Stay concise yet thorough.

Must include:
- Main subject(s): appearance, age, ethnicity (if relevant), clothing, pose, facial expression, hair, body language, exact positioning

Write in complete, flowing sentences — never use tag lists, commas, or prompt-style keywords.

Describe spatial relationships clearly and naturally.

Phrase avoidances positively (example: “simple clean clothing that fully covers the body”, “plain background without text or logos”).

Output ONLY the final prompt. No explanations, no notes, nothing else.
